title: Python Loops
description: Python has two primitive loop commands: while loops and for loops.

challenges.title: While Loop
challenges.exercise: Print i as long as i is less than 6. Start i at 1.

challenges.title: Break Statement
challenges.exercise: In a while loop, exit the loop when i is 3. Start i at 1.

challenges.title: For Loop
challenges.exercise: Loop through the items in ['apple', 'banana'] and print each.

challenges.title: Range Function
challenges.exercise: Use the range() function to loop 6 times (0 to 5) and print each.

challenges.title: Else in For
challenges.exercise: In a for x in range(3), print x, then print 'Done' after the loop using else.
